note: One entry per registered call. `post` is the X post id of the call, `asset` the ticker it names, `side` long or short, `ca` the coin address once launched. Every number on the site — the post's views, the caller's followers, the asset's price now and at the time of the call — is read live from X, Yahoo Finance, Dexscreener and Blockscout. Nothing here is a number.
